validation.tooling_skip_reason: Windows: Unix release directory aliases require symbolic links

comparison.reason: Previous retains the complete 483-case run; latest intentionally measures only the six direct-access cases. No unmeasured full-suite results are carried forward.
comparison.previous_summary_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sorted keys; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline
comparison.paired_versions_basis: Identical workload sources, inputs, compiler flags, machine, CPU affinity and per-process measurement settings. Build identity differs by source version.

limitations: Direct cases measure ordinary field/method access and include one Vela host entry per 128 operations.
These ratios do not measure reflection API overhead. No host-entry overhead is subtracted.
Only the six direct cases were remeasured; the earlier complete suite is retained as previous.
All samples, including high-variation samples, are retained. See per-case CV.
